source.name: Redis Agent Filesystem
source.checkout_state: fresh clone; clean after build except compiled binary ignored by git status

host_inotify.dominant_existing_watch_holder: VS Code process PID 108856 had 523947 watch descriptors before the rerun

negative_or_caveat_evidence.sync_watcher: v1/v2 mount logs report afs sync cannot watch mounted directories: no space left on device; host diagnosis found fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288 and VS Code PID 108856 holding 523947 watches; raising max_user_watches to 1048576 removed the allocation error for v4
negative_or_caveat_evidence.mounted_edit_sync: even after the v4 rerun without the inotify allocation error, local edits made under the mounted directory were not observed through fs get/find, the fork grep printed no match, and checkpoint diff reported 0 changes
negative_or_caveat_evidence.create_exclusive_attempt: fs --volume lifecycle-v3-vol create-exclusive failed: Workspace is not supported with fs create-exclusive; use the mounted sync workspace
negative_or_caveat_evidence.v3_cleanup: Redis was shut down and a best-effort workspace unmount cleanup was recorded

workload_shape: import local directory into named volume
reuse_verdict: Use Redis AFS as a source-backed agent workspace lifecycle workload seed for create/import/mount/query/checkpoint/bookmark/fork/unmount behavior. Do not claim live mounted edit synchronization on this host: v1/v2 hit host inotify exhaustion, and v4 still did not reflect mounted edits in Redis-backed fs queries after the inotify limit was raised.
